relationships.subject: Gingerols-enriched ginger
relationships.evidence_quote: GEG administration resulted in significantly lower GFAP gene expression in both tissues compared with untreated DNP rats.

relationships.subject: Gingerols-enriched ginger
relationships.evidence_quote: Supplementation of GEG led to decreased gene expression of TNF-α in the colon.

relationships.subject: Gingerols-enriched ginger
relationships.evidence_quote: the GEG group had decreased DNP1 mRNA expression in the spinal cord

relationships.subject: Gingerols-enriched ginger
relationships.evidence_quote: Supplementation of GEG into the diet significantly increased the CD11b mRNA expression in the colon

key_findings: Dietary GEG reduced mechanical hypersensitivity and anxio-depressive behavior in diabetic neuropathy rats, lowering GFAP, DRP1 and TNF-α and raising CD11b in colon and spinal cord.
